exposure: Newborns with at least one positive SARS-CoV-2 test
outcome: Need for resuscitation in the delivery room
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 265 pregnant women in a high-risk maternity hospital in Brazil
finding: Pregnant women exposed to or infected with SARS-CoV-2 had a higher incidence of preterm delivery, cesarean section, and other adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Patients exposed or infected with SARS-CoV-2 had a higher incidence of cesarean section.
